body:
## Purpose

Makes it possible to run the default ClimaLand model at any FLUXNET2015 site, with the same pattern as the fluxnet and ERA5 tutorials:

```julia
site_ID_val = FluxnetSimulations.replace_hyphen(site_ID)
(; time_offset, lat, long) = FluxnetSimulations.get_location(FT, Val(site_ID_val))
(; atmos_h) = FluxnetSimulations.get_fluxtower_height(FT, Val(site_ID_val))
domain = Column(; zlim, nelements, dz_tuple, longlat = (long, lat))
forcing = FluxnetSimulations.prescribed_forcing_fluxnet(site_ID, lat, long, time_offset, atmos_h, start_date, toml_dict, FT)
LAI = ClimaLand.Canopy.prescribed_climatological_lai_modis(domain.space.surface)
land = LandModel{FT}(forcing, LAI, toml_dict, domain, Δt)
```

## Content

- `get_location` and `get_fluxtower_height` now work at any FLUXNET2015 site. US-MOz, US-NR1, US-Ha1 and US-Var keep their hardcoded values; every other site falls back to the FLUXNET2015 metadata table (tower height = highest atmospheric sensor).
- New `fluxnet2015` artifact entry and `Artifacts.fluxnet2015_data_path()`. The artifact is too large to be downloadable; see the `fluxnet2015` entry in ClimaArtifacts for how to obtain it. `experiment_fluxnet_data_path` resolves any other site to its FULLSET half-hourly (or hourly) CSV. The four sites of the downloadable `fluxnet_sites` artifact do not need it.
- Metadata helpers: `get_site_info`, `get_canopy_height`, `get_site_igbp`.
- Robustness for arbitrary sites:
  - `get_data_dates(...; required_columns)` trims leading and trailing rows where any forcing column is missing. Gaps inside the record are linearly interpolated by the forcing TimeVaryingInputs (now documented).
  - Initial conditions fall back cleanly when a column is entirely missing, and `get_data_at_start_date` gives an informative error instead of failing inside `argmin` on an empty column.
  - Fractional UTC offsets (e.g. 9.5 for sites in central Australia) are supported.
- `er` (from `RECO_NT_VUT_REF`) is added to the fluxnet comparison data.
- `experiments/integrated/generic_site/`: `run_generic_site.jl` (runs the default `LandModel` at a site and plots it against observations), `list_fluxnet_sites.jl` and a README.
- Buildkite: a `generic_site BE-Vie run` step, which exercises the `fluxnet2015` metadata and data paths.
- Unit tests for the metadata helpers (against a small CSV fixture) and `get_data_dates(...; required_columns)`.

Existing site runs (`run_fluxnet.jl`, `ozark_pft.jl`, ...) are unchanged. They still use their curated CSVs and MODIS LAI for the actual years.

## Testing

Sites outside `fluxnet_sites` can only be run where the `fluxnet2015` artifact is available; the BE-Vie buildkite step covers that path. `run_generic_site.jl US-MOz` was run locally.
